content: अग्रिम {%a.%} [अग्रे भवः; अग्र-डिमच् <ls>P. IV. 3. 23. Vārt.</ls>] .²1 First (in order, rank <ab>&c.</ab>); foremost, best, excellent, preferable, superior; वीराणामग्रिमो भूत्वा युयुधे पार्थिवैः सह <ls>Mb.</ls> .²2 Prior, preceding. .²3 Elder, eldest. .²4 Furthest, advanced, first ripe. .²5 Further. .{@-मः@} An elder brother. .{@-मा@} A kind of fruit, Annona Reticulata. (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>रामफळ</ns>).
